notes.title: Steam Racing Fest – Carbox Demo is Live Again!
notes.content:
[p]Carbox is taking part in the [b]Steam Racing Fest[/b], and to celebrate, the demo is live once more, now updated with several new features, gameplay improvements, and fresh content. Here's what's new:[/p][list][*][p][b]Recommended Category:[/b]
Some maps and races now suggest the ideal car category for the event, helping players make smarter choices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rumble Support:[/b]
Controller vibration has been added for a more immersive driving experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Police Chase Improvements:[/b]
Police cars now crash and are destroyed when hitting walls. We've also rebalanced the police events to make them more manageable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fuel Consumption Feature:[/b]
Fuel is now a gameplay mechanic! In supported maps, your fuel will gradually deplete. Refill it by collecting fuel tanks scattered along the way. Don’t forget to watch your fuel gauge![/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Optimization:[/b]
Many official maps have been refined and optimized for better performance, especially on older systems. More improvements are on the way![/p][/*][*][p][b]New F1-Inspired Car:[/b]
We’ve added a brand-new Formula-style car to your collection![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]And much more:[/b]
Many fixes, polish, and tweaks throughout the game to improve the experience.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Temporarily Removing the Carbox Demo Until the Next Event
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! Just a heads-up: we are removing the demo from Steam until the next event.[/p][p]In the meantime, we’ll be polishing things up and continuing development.[/p][p]Thanks so much for all the feedback and ideas!![/p]

notes.title: Carbox Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve just rolled out an update with two new unlocked rookie cars, designed to be easy to handle for new players. We’ve also heard your feedback about the steering sensitivity and learning curve, so we’ve added a new sensitivity slider to let you fine-tune the controls to your preference.

Your input is invaluable, and we’ll keep improving the game based on your suggestions. Thanks for playing and supporting Carbox!

The Carbox Team

notes.title: Carbox Demo is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After almost four years of development, we're thrilled to announce that the Carbox Demo is finally live! We have been working hard to bring this vision to life, and we can't wait for you to experience it.

Carbox is a unique mix of racing action and world-building creativity. In this demo, you'll get a first taste of what the game is all about. Race through dynamic tracks, compete for the best times, unlock new cars, and build your own worlds. Then share them with other players and explore what the community creates.

From our small but dedicated team, thank you for playing. We hope you enjoy what we've built so far, and we can’t wait to see what you create!

We’d love to hear your feedback and ideas to help us keep improving and growing Carbox.

Catch you on the track!
Daniel
